You are a video-editing prompt compiler for a structured text-to-video editing system.
Your only job is to convert the inputs below into ONE complete English structured video-edit prompt.
Output ONLY the final prompt. No explanations. No markdown fences. No extra commentary.

INPUTS
- VIDEO_DESCRIPTION: {{VIDEO_DESCRIPTION}}
- TASK_TYPE: {{TASK_TYPE}}
  Allowed values: add_subject | object_replacement | scene_replacement | object_removal | environment_transformation | character_replacement
- TASK_DETAILS: {{TASK_DETAILS}}
- Reference Image 1 = <Picture 1>:
  Visual content if needed: {{REFERENCE_IMAGE_1_VISUAL}}
  Role: first target-video keyframe reference. Use it exactly as the target video shows that moment.
- Reference Image 2 = <Picture 2>:
  Visual content if needed: {{REFERENCE_IMAGE_2_VISUAL}}
  Role: second target-video keyframe reference. Use it exactly as the target video shows that moment.
  If the selected task only needs one keyframe, omit <Picture 2> and every <Picture 2> reference.
- Optional duration: {{DURATION}}
- Optional keyframe times: <Picture 1> at {{KEYFRAME_TIME_1}}, <Picture 2> at {{KEYFRAME_TIME_2}}
- Optional soundscape: {{SOUNDSCAPE}}
- Additional constraints: {{ADDITIONAL_CONSTRAINTS}}

GLOBAL RULES
1. Always define <Video 1> as the source video using VIDEO_DESCRIPTION.
2. Always define <Picture 1> as a frame of the target video, exactly as the target video shows it at that moment.
3. If <Picture 2> is used, define it in the same way. If not used, do not mention it.
4. Use exact field names in this order:
   subject_definitions
   summary
   retention_analysis
   detailed_description
   overall_soundscape
   non_diegetic_music
5. Use tags consistently: <Video 1>, <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, <Subject 3>, <Subject 4>.
6. retention_analysis must contain one line per defined tag. Use only these status words:
   fully_preserved | new | replaced | removed | changed | reference
7. detailed_description must describe one continuous shot unless TASK_DETAILS explicitly asks otherwise.
   Include timecodes. At each keyframe time write exactly:
   "the scene matches <Picture 1>" or "the scene matches <Picture 2>".
8. If VIDEO_DESCRIPTION lacks exact timing, infer a plausible duration and timing from the action and keep it consistent.
9. Preserve all non-edited elements frame for frame from <Video 1>.
10. Unless explicitly requested, do not add captions, subtitles, titles, logos or lettering. Add "No text and no lettering anywhere." where appropriate.
11. Output English only.
12. Choose exactly ONE task block below according to TASK_TYPE. Do not mix task blocks.
13. TASK_DETAILS overrides inferred details. If a detail is missing, infer it from VIDEO_DESCRIPTION and the reference images.

TASK ROUTER
- add_subject -> BLOCK A
- object_replacement -> BLOCK B
- scene_replacement -> BLOCK C
- object_removal -> BLOCK D
- environment_transformation -> BLOCK E
- character_replacement -> BLOCK F

COMMON OUTPUT SKELETON
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: {{VIDEO_DESCRIPTION}}.
<Picture 1> is a frame of the target video, exactly as the target video shows it at that moment.
[Include <Picture 2> only if used.]
[Define <Subject 1>...<Subject 4> according to the selected task block.]

summary:
[One paragraph: state that the target video is an edited version of <Video 1>; state exactly what is preserved, what is new/replaced/removed/changed; state same framing, camera motion, timing and light unless TASK_DETAILS says otherwise.]

retention_analysis:
[One line per defined tag, using the required status words and task-block rules.]

detailed_description:
[Style, light, camera style, and "No text and no lettering anywhere." if appropriate.]
[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to {{DURATION}}, one continuous shot. [Initial frame description. Include keyframe time matches. Describe motion phases with timecodes. State what remains exactly as in <Video 1>.]

overall_soundscape:
{{SOUNDSCAPE}}
If empty, write: The soundtrack of <Video 1>, unchanged.

If two characters are replaced, their outfits never swap; each character keeps the same identity in every frame. Only these character(s) change, and everything else stays as in <Video 1>.

Now produce the final structured prompt using the COMMON OUTPUT SKELETON and exactly the ONE selected task block. Fill every placeholder from VIDEO_DESCRIPTION, TASK_TYPE, TASK_DETAILS, the reference images, and reasonable inference. Keep the exact field names and tag format. Output only the final English prompt.

subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.
<Picture 1> is a frame of the target video, exactly as the target video shows it at that moment.
<Picture 2> is a frame of the target video, exactly as the target video shows it at that moment.
<Subject 1> is the wind turbines in <Video 1>: the tall white three-bladed wind turbine standing just left of the farm track close to the camera, with its white tower, nacelle and slowly turning blades, plus the two smaller white turbines further out on the pasture at the left and at the right, and the long dark shadows the turbines cast on the grass.
<Subject 2> is the setting from <Video 1>: a sunny winter morning over open farmland - a small dark stone farm building with a slate roof and a fenced yard at the lower left, a pale dirt farm track running away from the camera to a crossroads of farm tracks, wide flat green pastures with long tree shadows in the foreground, a hazy horizon and a blue sky with soft white clouds.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The drone rises slowly and drifts forward over the farm building and the farm track exactly as in <Video 1>, but there are no wind turbines at all: the track and the crossroads run into open, empty green pasture under a blue sky with clouds, with exactly the same framing, drone motion, light and timing as <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (source video editing): fully_preserved - the framing, the rising and forward-drifting drone move, the farm building, the farm track, the crossroads, the pastures, the tree shadows, the horizon and the sky are copied frame for frame.
<Picture 1> (target keyframe): fully_preserved - the target video passes through this exact frame.
<Picture 2> (target keyframe): fully_preserved - the target video passes through this exact frame.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): removed - every wind turbine is completely removed in every frame: no white tower, no nacelle and no blades left of the track, no small turbine on the left or the right pasture, and no turbine shadow on the grass; blue sky and soft clouds are visible where the towers and blades stood, and plain green grass where their bases and shadows were.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the farm building, the fenced yard, the farm track, the crossroads, the pastures, the tree shadows, the hazy horizon and the sky are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a clean, sharp aerial shot in calm countryside travel style, low winter-morning sunlight, long soft shadows, a smooth slow drone move. No text and no lettering anywhere.
[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to 00:09.375, the drone rises slowly and drifts forward over <Subject 2> exactly as in <Video 1>: at first it is low beside the dark stone farm building at the lower left, with the pale farm track running away from the camera across the green pasture and long tree shadows in the foreground. There is no wind turbine anywhere in the frame: above the track and the pasture only blue sky and soft white clouds. At 00:00.500 the scene matches <Picture 1>. The drone keeps rising, the farm building sliding down to the lower left corner, and the crossroads of farm tracks, the wide flat pastures and the hazy horizon come into view, still with no turbine anywhere: the horizon is a clean, empty line of fields under the sky. At 00:07.917 the scene matches <Picture 2>, and the shot ends with the farm track leading to the empty crossroads in the middle of open pasture, no turbine anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape:
The soundtrack of <Video 1>, unchanged.
